_comment: Brokers whose playbook lives under another id, because one document covers
them all. Used by validate.py (does an acted-on broker have a playbook?)
and playbook_audit.py (is that playbook still current?).
One source of truth on purpose: the two checks disagreed while each kept a
private copy of this list, and the audit reported six missing playbooks that
were in fact written -- under the family name.
Only add an entry when the shared document genuinely covers the broker's
route. Brands that merely share an owner but have separate opt-out flows
